name: Netphen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged in the upper third with the city arms of Netphen (a black boar on yellow beneath blue).
history: The arms were granted by deed of the Oberpräsident of the Province of Westphalia of 17 August 1937; by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg of 8 March 1974 the city was granted the right to bear arms, a seal and a banner, described as blue and yellow striped 1:1 with the city shield in the middle of the upper third.

features.role: Netphen arms — boar on yellow beneath blue
